test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7156e57dd41db598c23e163cf640dfd8ee6b8ea0815725b9cbaa29a30b747322.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: EJLP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a142fed404ac015d1998a27ebbdc96919010d033bd69c8e87c17de3d26b82b2c.png] 

Option 2: VACG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb251e5efcb134c2cdbe41b06b935980bda2f1ee37b74e3312e859ce9ab75c57.png] 

Option 3: QVXB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7e8e43d574fec7108b16bcff64e49adbeec2562cdfb993bc0b36b6a69b4ac18.png] 

Option 4: TYBF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56829f19fc19ae2860d9767e4d40fa9addcad7717a0ea0c84ab7d0c85c3788c7.png] 

Thus, TYBF does not belong to the group.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 4.**
